title: Kissed with Garlic Filipino Chicken Grill
description: Garlicky, tender, adventurous Filipino dish featuring caster sugar, char-grill-yang, dairy-free-friendly. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and garlic, making sure they're evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, mix the caster sugar, fish sauce, vinegar, and a pinch of salt. Brush the mixture on both sides of the chicken breasts, making sure to get the edges as well.
Thread the marinated chicken breasts onto skewers, if using, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the chicken breasts on the preheated grill, skin side down for 5 minutes or until nicely charred.
Flip the chicken breasts and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes or until they're cooked through.
Remove the chicken breasts from the grill and let them rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing.
While the chicken is resting, mix the patis with a squeeze of lime juice and a pinch of salt. Brush the mixture onto the grilled chicken breasts.
Slice the chicken breasts and serve with a side of steamed rice or vegetables, garnished with a sprinkle of fresh herbs, if desired.
For a more authentic Filipino experience, wrap the grilled chicken breasts in banana leaves before serving.
Serve with steamed rice or vegetables and a side of steamed bok choy or spinach.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, adding more patis or vinegar if desired.
Garnish with a sprinkle of chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, for added color and freshness.
